HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the foundation of all web pages. It's a markup language, meaning it uses tags to structure content. These tags tell the browser how to display the content. Here's a breakdown of its key components: **Basic Structure:** Every HTML document follows a basic structure: ```html Page Title

This is a heading

This is a paragraph.

``` * **``:** This declaration tells the browser that the document is an HTML5 document. It's crucial for proper rendering. * **``:** The root element of the page. Everything else goes inside it. * **``:** Contains meta-information about the HTML document, such as the title, character set, and links to external resources (like stylesheets). The content of the `` is not displayed directly on the page. * **``:** Specifies a title for the HTML page (which is shown in the browser's title bar or tab). * **`<body>`:** Contains the visible page content, including headings, paragraphs, images, links, etc. **Key Elements:** * **Headings:** `<h1>` to `<h6>` (h1 being the largest, h6 the smallest). Used to structure content hierarchically. * **Paragraphs:** `<p>` Creates a paragraph of text. * **Links:** `<a href="URL">Link text</a>` Creates a hyperlink to another webpage or resource. `href` attribute specifies the URL. * **Images:** `<img src="image.jpg" alt="Description of image">` Inserts an image. `src` specifies the image's location, and `alt` provides alternative text for screen readers and if the image fails to load. * **Lists:** * **Unordered lists:** `<ul><li>Item 1</li><li>Item 2</li></ul>` Uses bullet points. * **Ordered lists:** `<ol><li>Item 1</li><li>Item 2</li></ol>` Uses numbers. * **Divisions and Spans:** * **`<div>`:** A block-level element, used to group content and apply styles. * **`<span>`:** An inline element, used to style specific parts of text within a line. * **Tables:** `<table>`, `<tr>` (table row), `<td>` (table data), `<th>` (table header). Used to structure data in rows and columns. **Example with more elements:** ```html <!DOCTYPE html> <html> <head> <title>My Webpage

Welcome to my website!

This is a paragraph of text.

  • Item 1
  • Item 2
Link to Example ``` This is a simplified overview. HTML has many more elements and attributes for creating complex web pages. To learn more, explore resources like the MDN Web Docs (Mozilla Developer Network): [https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML)
